item.text:
Reconfirmed the two public integration defects together across 10 consecutive repetitions. Both failed every time:

- Package-level `GetConfiguration` returned an empty committed configuration.
- `NewRaft` rejected a valid commit-tracking store wrapped by `LogCache`.

This result is recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_09-39-48-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md). Run ID: `56a94fad04804b5baba260a4294d4098`.

No additional finding was added. The audit remains at eight findings with captured source unchanged.
